function: Learned CSI feedback compression with codeword length adapted per image by a learned PSNR evaluator, serving a CSI-aware MIMO semantic image transmission system, DeepSC-MIMO (pp. 9-18).
system: Nt=16 transmit, Nr=16 receive antennas, d=2 streams, SVD precoding; narrowband mmWave clustered channel; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 21).
method: DeepSC-MIMO: CNN/ResNet autoencoder with CSI and noise attention; CLNet autoencoder for CSI feedback; evaluator by knowledge distillation; MSE autoencoder training, evaluator by regression (pp. 11-16, 21).
data_channel: CIFAR10 images (50,000 train, 10,000 test) over a simulated narrowband mmWave clustered MIMO channel of [41] with AWGN; no 3GPP or measured channel (p. 21).
test_conditions: Trained at 18 dB SNR or SNR uniform in [6,18] dB, tested from -6 to 18 dB; 16x16 and 8x8 antenna cases; CIFAR10 test split (pp. 21-23).
baselines: Non-learned: BPG+LDPC with 16QAM/4QAM. Learned: DJSCC [4] and DJSCC with fixed CSI codeword length; CSI codec is CLNet [28] (pp. 21, 27-28).
metrics: PSNR (dB), semantic distortion outage probability (SDOP), CSI codeword length (feedback overhead), evaluator prediction MSE, model parameters (pp. 21-28).
complexity: Number of parameters only: DeepSC-MIMO 0.488M; performance evaluator 0.311M, 0.142M, 0.058M (basic, small, tiny); no FLOPs or runtime (Table I, p. 25).
q1_support: p. 21: "We employ the popular narrowband millimeter wave (mmWave) clustered channel [41]". Simulated clustered channel from a beamforming paper; no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, COST 2100, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 22: "We train the proposed DeepSC-MIMO model with SNR = 18 dB and test it in SNR" over a range; an SNR sweep does not count. The 16x16 and 8x8 cases are not described as train/test shifts, and testing uses the CIFAR10 test split (p. 21).
q3_support: p. 21: "we adopt the BPG source coding and the advanced low-density parity-check (LDPC) channel coding" (non-learned) and "we also compare the DeepSC-MIMO with the classic DJSCC proposed in [4]" (earlier learned); PSNR in Fig. 7 (p. 22), SDOP vs DJSCC-fixed in Fig. 12b (p. 28).
q4_support: p. 25: "Table I compares the numbers of model parameters of different schemes"; Table I lists DeepSC-MIMO 0.488M and the evaluator 0.311M, 0.142M, 0.058M. Only parameter counts, no FLOPs or runtime.
q5_support: p. 21: "We use the CIFAR10 dataset", a public dataset of the learning task alone, sent over simulated channels. No code or data link or DOI appears in the paper.
notes: Preprint arXiv:2306.15534v1 of the TCCN article. Area 2 because the evaluated outcome is learned adaptive CSI feedback compression (codeword length vs SDOP, Figs. 11-12). The CSI codec is CLNet [28], trained within the system (p. 20). Borderline: if the reviewer judges the codec off-the-shelf and the contribution to be semantic JSCC, the exclusion would be function. Precoder and combiner use SVD, not learned (p. 10). The q3 comparisons on PSNR and SDOP are for image transmission; the adaptive feedback itself is compared only with fixed-length feedback.
